response.sql: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) AS side_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.dealedge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.dealedge), side_average AS (SELECT AVG(side_count) AS average_count FROM side_counts) SELECT SUM(sc.side_count) AS total_count, AVG(sc.side_count - sa.average_count) AS average_excess FROM side_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN side_average AS sa WHERE sc.side_count > sa.average_count;
